mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen from -39.0 to -28.7 over three weeks and the latest week is a new high; this recovery momentum in discretionary footfall persists into August, lifting the next 28-day mean above the prior 28-day mean.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC rose from -39.0 at t-3w to -28.7 at t-0w
failure_condition: Next 28-day mean RETAIL_REC is less than or equal to the prior 28-day mean despite the three-week improving trend.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT falls below -40.0 on a weekly mean, it signals renewed movement restrictions or fear severe enough to suppress non-essential shopping; RETAIL_REC then declines over the following two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT weakened to -38.6 at t-0w from -37.0 at t-1w
failure_condition: After TRANSIT crosses below -40.0, the next 14-day mean RETAIL_REC is not lower than the prior 14-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Joint recovery in GROCERY_PHARM toward baseline and PARKS toward baseline indicates broad mobility normalization, not just essential errands; this lifts discretionary retail footfall over four weeks.

failure_condition: When GROCERY_PHARM is above -5.0 and PARKS is above -30.0, the next 28-day mean RETAIL_REC is not higher.

mechanism_narrative: Under partial reopening with work-from-home guidance, elevated RESIDENTIAL and depressed WORKPLACES keep weekday retail footfall below prior levels; RETAIL_REC remains lower over four weeks.

failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL > 20.0 and WORKPLACES < -30.0, the next 28-day mean RETAIL_REC is not lower.

mechanism_narrative: A widening gap between GROCERY_PHARM near baseline and RETAIL_REC deeply negative means consumers still limit discretionary visits; the gap closes slowly, so retail stays below prior mean.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM was -2.4 versus RETAIL_REC -28.7 at t-0w
failure_condition: When the gap exceeds 15 points, next 14-day mean RETAIL_REC is not lower.

mechanism_narrative: Transit and workplace mobility both weakened in t-0w while retail was flat, indicating the easing of restrictions has stalled; retail footfall follows with a one-week lag and declines over the next week.

failure_condition: After both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES fall week-on-week, next 7-day mean RETAIL_REC is not lower.
